limitations: One separately declared priority-motion candidate; all prior network and free-field results are retained and no old arm is replayed.
The same two synthetic scenes serve both fitting and measurement; no generalization, Atari competence, perception, transfer or accelerated learning is established.
Priorities are predicted from past ordered RGB, own appearance embeddings and own predicted flow. Future RGB is only the loss target; no external priority, mask, identity or motion label is provided.

Virgin visual-model weights must be exactly those of the original ordered model at seed764, and initial log priorities exactly zero. Initial native scalars have a prospectively declared absolute tolerance2e-7 due to changed accumulation; the final criterion has no tolerance.
256Adam updates, lr3e-4, batch2, beta0.9/0.999, epsilon1e-8, no weight decay and maxnorm1. Only the mean L1 over widths1/3/7 of the priority reconstruction is optimized; no m/C/G/I objective.
Final native RGB L1 must remain strictly below0.01171875. Filtered loss, priority statistics and final diagnostic fields/arrays are recorded separately.

Architecture and renderer arithmetic have changed; a difference cannot be causally attributed to priority alone. Image fitting does not identify physical motion, calibrated visibility, foreground or control.
CPU one numerical thread, no emulator, real archive or GPU.300second cooperative work bound excluding proof hashing. No reusable trained agent checkpoint.

One attempt with no seed replacement or extension. In-progress optimizer calls are marked in memory and persisted in finally; a hard kill can leave only an uncertain started marker and never permits retry.
Independent preceding-result/operator/head reviews and exact committed source/protocol/preflight are required before the first real update.
